annotations.title: Count the files of documents to download

description: Use when the user wants to download the files of public exploration reports and publications, to count the files and their size first. It saves the count as an estimate, under an id that prepare_download takes; nothing is packaged, sent, charged or deleted. Give `documents` [{corpus, key}] from a search, `anumbers` for WAMEX reports, a GeoThought `project_id` of the user's, or an `area` (a polygon, or a point and radius) to cover the reports there plus that area's public data layers as CSV/GeoJSON; up to 5,000 documents. Returns an estimate id, the number of files, the total size (and the PDFs' size alone), the documents with no files, and the number of ZIP parts (about 10 GB each). Tell the user the size before preparing anything. If `state` is still `estimating`, follow it with download_status.

area.description: {polygon: [[lon, lat], ...]} or {point: [lon, lat], radius_km} (at most 50 km); at most 25,000 km².

documents.description: Documents as {corpus, key}, e.g. {corpus: "wamex", key: "A12345"} or {corpus: "sarig", key: "env01234"}: the corpus and key a search or document tool returned.

name.description: What to call the package (the ZIP and email use it).

project_id.description: A GeoThought project the user can see.
